config.farmstead_footprints.title: Footprints settings
config.farmstead_footprints.preset.toolt: Sets every value below at once. Values you change afterwards are kept.
config.farmstead_footprints.general.enab: Master switch. Off: no prints are made or drawn.
config.farmstead_footprints.general.chec: Once at start-up, ask Modrinth whether a newer Footprints is out and say so in the log. Sends nothing about you.
config.farmstead_footprints.footprints.m: How many prints can exist at once. The oldest disappear first when the limit is reached.
config.farmstead_footprints.footprints.r: Blocks from the camera within which prints are made and drawn.
config.farmstead_footprints.footprints.l: Multiplies how long prints stay before they fade (snow 5 min, sand 3 min at 1.0).
config.farmstead_footprints.footprints.e: Entities that never leave prints, by id or #tag, separated by commas. Flying and footless mobs are listed by default.
config.farmstead_footprints.footprints.s: Sneaking feet leave shallow prints, or none at all (stealth).
config.farmstead_footprints.footprints.i: Invisible players and mobs leave prints too.
config.farmstead_footprints.footprints.p: Your own rules per mob or #tag, separated by commas, e.g. minecraft:fox = shape:paw size:0.8. Shapes: boot, bare, paw, cat, hoof, cloven, bird, big, bear, or your own picture from config/farmstead_footprints/textures.
config.farmstead_footprints.surfaces.har: Any block softer than this takes prints, modded ones too (sand 0.5, grass and gravel 0.6, wool 0.8). 0: only the listed blocks.
config.farmstead_footprints.surfaces.inc: Blocks that always take prints, by id or #tag, separated by commas.
config.farmstead_footprints.surfaces.exc: Blocks that never take prints, by id or #tag, separated by commas; wins over everything else.
farmstead_footprints.command.problems: Footprints settings: %s problem(s), see below. Fix the file and run /footprints reload again.
farmstead_footprints.command.stats: Footprints: %s prints of %s, drawn last frame: %s.
